rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever heeds admonition, restrains desire, and stops persisting is granted respite in the present.
rows.anchor: ومن انتبه بزواجر الوعظ ، وكبح لجام الهوى ، ولم يطلق عنان الإصرار فله الإمهال في الحال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If he returns to those blameworthy states, he should expect near eradication and sudden punishment.
rows.anchor: فإن عاد إلى مذموم تلك الأحوال فلينتظروا أوشك الاستئصال وفجاءة النكال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Actions undertaken by God's leave are accompanied by good and blessing.
rows.anchor: ما كان بإذن منه - سبحانه - من التصرفات فمقرون بالخيرات ، ومصحوب بالبركات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Actions that follow caprice invite erasure, and their outcome is loss.
rows.anchor: وما كان بمتابعة الهوى يسلط عليه المحق ، وكانت عاقبة أمره الخسران

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A Muslim is better served by relying on what the Lord promises than attaching the heart to what the self wants.
rows.anchor: الاكتفاء بموعود الرب خير للمسلم من تعليق قلبه بمقصود نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The self's desired object comes from its suggestions, whereas the divine promise comes from what the Real has guaranteed.
rows.anchor: مقصودك من تسويلات النفس ، وموعودك مما ضمنه الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One who persists in wrongdoing has no weight, value, or standing with God.
rows.anchor: إن صاحب الإصرار ليس له عندنا وزن ولا مقدار ، ولا قدر ولا أخطار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once a judge establishes that an imprisoned debtor is insolvent, the judge may not continue imprisoning him.
rows.anchor: إذا تقرر عند القاضي إفلاس المحبوس فلا تحل له استدامة حبسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The creditor's established claim remains the debtor's obligation, but the insolvent debtor is granted delay and respite.
rows.anchor: وإن ظهرت لذي الحق حجة المفلس فذلك مرتهن بحق خصمه ، ولكنه في إمهال وإنظار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God treats human beings with mercy despite knowing their insolvency, incapacity, sincere need, and exclusive turning to Him.
rows.anchor: فمع علمه بإعسارنا وعجزنا ، وصدق افتقارنا إليه وانقطاعنا له - يرحمنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The insolvent debtor has no income from assets or commercial capital; an indebtedness allotment is the only financial avenue, while one destitute in livelihood depends solely on his Master.
rows.anchor: ليس للفقير المفلس وجه يحصل له منه شيء إلا من حيث ما جعل الله سبحانه من سهم الغارمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Return is bodily and personal at resurrection, and inward through the heart's accounting in every breath.
rows.anchor: الرجوع على ضربين : بالأبشار والنفوس غدا عند التوفي ، وبالأسرار والقلوب في كل نفس محاسبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The present accounting and demand are more pressing than the promised reckoning that will occur at resurrection.
rows.anchor: فنقد مطالبته أحق مما سيكون في القيامة من وعده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The common people are told to fear a Day, while the elect are told to fear God Himself.
rows.anchor: وقال للعوام : { واتقوا يوما } وقال للخواص : { وإياى فاتقون }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's instructions for honest dealings, precaution, and witness testimony express mercy and gentleness, preventing people from wronging and disputing with one another.
rows.anchor: أمر الله سبحانه الخلق بالقيام بالصدق ، وعلمهم كيفية معاملاتهم فيما بينهم ، والأخذ بالاحتياط والاستشهاد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rights should be secured in writing and by witnesses, who must first bear testimony and then give it.
rows.anchor: فأمر بتحصين الحقوق بالكتابة والإشهاد ، وأمر الشهود بالتحمل ثم بالإقامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since law ends disputes among people now, God can remove the traces of their disputes in the afterlife.
rows.anchor: ومن شرع اليوم ما يقطع الخصومة بينهم فبالحري أن يجري ما يرفع في الآخرة آثار الخصومة بينهم

rows.speaker: الخبر المنقول
rows.claim: A transmitted report says people should relinquish claims among themselves because the Generous pardons when able.
rows.anchor: وفي الخبر المنقول : ( تواهبوا فيما بينكم فقد وهبت منكم مالي عليكم ، فإن الكريم إذا قدر غفر )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Earlier scriptures sent to the messengers also carried mention of Muhammad, and God adorned the remembrances He revealed with his mention.
rows.anchor: أي إنا أنزلنا قبلك كتبنا على المرسلين فما أخلينا كتابا من ذكرك

rows.speaker: قائلهم
rows.claim: An unnamed poet says the pages kept for absent beloveds are titled with their remembrance, illustrating the honor of prophetic remembrance.
rows.anchor: قال قائلهم : وعندي لأحبابنا الغائبين . . . صحائف ذكرك عنوانها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The severe punishment of those who reject God's signs is the humiliation of being veiled from Him, though they do not perceive it.
rows.anchor: وهو ذل الحجاب ، ولكنهم لا يشعرون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is mighty toward His allies and exacts vengeance on His enemies; everyone seeks Him, but few find Him.
rows.anchor: عزيز يطلبه كل أحد ، ولكن لا يجده - كثيرا - أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God counts every breath, originates every atom in heaven and earth, and governs every person's attributes.
rows.anchor: لا يتنفس عبد نفسا إلا والله سبحانه وتعالى محصيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In particular, He grants every need brought to Him and suffices anyone who turns to Him in a crisis.
rows.anchor: فلا رفع أحد إليه حاجة إلا وهو قاضيها ، ولا رجع أحد إليه في نازلة إلا وهو كافيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God forms people in the wombs in the ongoing order of creation and had already decreed their states in eternity through His judgment and apportionment.
rows.anchor: هذا فيما لا يزال من حيث الخلقة ، وهو الذي قدر أحوالكم في الأزل كيف شاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's judgment cannot be overturned, and His decree cannot be opposed through neglect or rejection.
rows.anchor: فلا يعقب حكمه بالنقض ، أو يعارض تقديره بالإهمال والرفض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Divine address includes clear outward revelation and difficult, subtle interpretation: the first guides outward practice, while the second protects secrets from outsiders.
rows.anchor: فمن ظاهر واضح تنزيله ، ومن غامض مشكل تأويله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Scholars should seek meanings consistent with foundational principles, accept what they can grasp, and submit what thought cannot resolve to the Knower of the unseen.
rows.anchor: فما حصل عليه الوقوف فمقابل بالقبول ، وما امتنع من التأثر فيه بمعلول الفكر سلموه إلى عالم الغيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People of spiritual indication listen with present hearts and build signs of unveiling from meanings that dawn on their understanding.
rows.anchor: وسبيل أهل الإشارة والفهم إلقاء السمع بحضور القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People of inward understanding keep silent when commanded to guard a secret and speak plainly when commanded to disclose the truth.
rows.anchor: إن ( طولبوا ) باستدامة الستر وطي السر تخارسوا عن النطق ، وإن أمروا بالإظهار والنشر أطلقوا بيان الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those aided by insight are illuminated by understanding, while people veiled by doubt lose subtle realization and sink into confusion, ignorance, and aversion.
rows.anchor: فأما الذين ايدوا بأنوار البصائر فمستضيئون بشعاع شموس الفهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those given knowledge by God believe from clear disclosure and pure certainty, without speculative thoughts roaming through possibilities.
rows.anchor: فيكون إيمانهم بلا احتمال جولان خواطر التجويز بل عن صريحات الظهور ، وصافيات اليقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sound minds accompany remembrance as proofs appear; their acquisition remains bound by reverence for what cannot be mastered.
rows.anchor: وأما أصحاب العقول الصاحية ففي صحبة التذكر ، لظهور البراهين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As the knowers grow nearer, they grow more courteous; preserving distance is one of the strongest ways to maintain reverence.
rows.anchor: ما ازدادوا قربا إلا ازدادوا أدبا ، واللياذ إلى التباعد أقوى أسباب رعاية الأدب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is said that sincere and gracious seeking of help is answered with lights of sufficiency.
rows.anchor: ويقال حين صدقوا في حسن الاستغانة أمدوا بأنوار الكفاية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gathering now is of beloveds on the carpet of nearness and of their secrets for disclosure of majesty and beauty; tomorrow all people and bodies gather for reward, punishment, and witnessed states.
rows.anchor: اليوم جمع الأحباب على بساط الاقتراب ، وغدا جمع الكافة لمحل الثواب والعقاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers will gain no ransom, aid, accepted wealth, lifted veil, or heard plea; they face Hell, banishment, and painful distance.
rows.anchor: فلا فداء ينفعهم ، ولا غناء يدفعهم ، ولا مال يقبل منهم ، ولا حجاب يرفع عنهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They persist in rebellion and do not taste any benefit; they regret their acts only after the door is shut and regret is no longer accepted.
rows.anchor: فلا عن الإصرار أقلعوا ، ولا في المبار طعموا ، ولعمري إنهم هم الذين ندموا وتحسروا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Disbelievers lose communion with the Real in the hereafter and life's pleasure in this world; their coming punishment by fire exceeds worldly separation from God, but diseased insight keeps them from sensing it.
rows.anchor: أخبرهم أنهم يفوتهم حديث الحق في الآجل ، ولا تكون لهم لذة عيش في العاجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By willing it, God makes much seem little to some and little seem great to others; blinded insight defeats even sharp sight, while an opened secret can overcome physical blindness.
rows.anchor: إذا أراد الله إمضاء أمر قلل الكثير في أعين قوم ، وكثر القليل في أعين قوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rejected people have no present success in their deeds or future fulfillment of hopes because they lack God's aid and never witnessed His might and power.
rows.anchor: أولئك الذين ليس لهم - اليوم - توفيق بأعمالهم ، ولا غدا تحقيق لآمالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God tested Muhammad through the call of people already known not to respond, and commands him to endure their refusal and bad condition.
rows.anchor: امتحناك بدعوة من سبق علمنا بأنهم لا يستجيبون ، فاصبر على ما أمرت فيهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They turn away because, by prior divine determination, they were deprived of God's gracious self-disclosure.
rows.anchor: لأنهم فقدوا منا حسن التجلي بسابق الإرادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gradually enticed them in worldly life until they judged themselves saved and their punishment light; they will learn of multiplied affliction and their false presumption.
rows.anchor: عاقبناهم في الدنيا بالاستدراج حتى حكموا لأنفسهم بالنجاة وتخفيف العقاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gathering and judgment leave wrongdoers stunned, their motives cut off and hearts rising to their throats, before account, rebuke, punishment, and denial of honor.
rows.anchor: هذه كلمة تعجب لما أخبر به عن تعظيم الأمر ، وتفخيم الشأن عند بهتة عقولهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers' resurrection occurs on the Day of Gathering, while the beloveds' resurrection occurs in the present moment.
rows.anchor: وقيامة الكفار يوم الحشر ، وقيامة الأحباب في الوقت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The vocative اللهم means يا الله, with the final mim serving in place of the call particle يا.
rows.anchor: ( اللهم ) معناها يا الله والميم في آخرها بدل عن حرف النداء وهو يا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse teaches people how to praise God by describing Him as the sole Master of kingship, with no partner or rival in essence, sovereignty, or creation.
rows.anchor: فهذا تعليم الحق كيفية الثناء على الحق ، أي صفني بما أستحقه من جلال القدر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone owns kingship; creatures receive it through submission to Him and lose it through arrogance toward Him.
rows.anchor: والملك من المخلوقين من تذلل له ، ومنزوع الملك ممن تكبر عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creatures' refinement lies in humble submission to the Real, their honor in effacing themselves in Him, and their continuance in annihilation through Him.
rows.anchor: فتجمل الخلق في تذللهم للحق ، وعزهم في محوهم فيه ، وبقاؤهم في فنائهم به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God exalts whom He wills through the honor of His essence.
rows.anchor: { وتعز من تشاء } . بعز ذاتك . { وتذل من تشاء } . بخذلانك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He exalts by guiding someone to witness and affirm His oneness, and debases by leaving someone to deny and lose Him; His turning brings favor, intimacy, and occupation with Him, while His aversion brings estrangement.
rows.anchor: بأن تهديه ليشهدك ويوحدك ، وتذل من تشاء بأن يجحدك ويفقدك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God exalts by overcoming the self's judgments and by the dawning of intimacy, but debases through the ego's domination and its sudden assaults.
rows.anchor: وتعز من تشاء بسقوط أحكام نفسه ، وتذل من تشاء بغلبة غاغة نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Divine expansion through Him is exaltation, while contraction away from Him is debasement.
rows.anchor: وتعز من تشاء ببسطه بك ، وتذل من تشاء بقبضه عنك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Receiving spiritual kingship means girding oneself for service; losing it means being removed from the court of worship.
rows.anchor: و { تؤتى الملك من تشاء } يشد نطاق خدمتك ، { وتنزع الملك ممن تشاء } بنفيه عن بساط عبادتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God grants kingship by singling someone's secret out for Him, and removes it by binding the person's heart to a creature.
rows.anchor: توتي الملك من تشاء بإفراد سره لك وتنزع الملك ممن تشاء بأن تربط قلبه بمخلوق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He exalts someone by establishing that person in divine will and debases someone by returning that person to habitual ways.
rows.anchor: { وتعز من تشاء } بإقامته بالإرادة ، { وتذل من تشاء } يرده إلى ما عليه أهل العادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse mentions good but omits evil to preserve the etiquette of address, favor good omens, and avoid ill omens.
rows.anchor: ولم يذكر الشر حفظا لآداب الخطاب ، وتفاؤلا بذكر الجميل ، وتطيرا من ذكر السوء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's power includes veiling and attraction, aid and abandonment, taking and returning, separation and union, and contraction and expansion.
rows.anchor: من الحجب والجذب ، ( والنصرة ) والخذلان ، والأخذ والرد ، والفرق والجمع ، والقبض والبسط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning night into day means the light of divine oneness overcomes the self's darkness and leaves none of its traces.
rows.anchor: حتى يغلب سلطان ضياء التوحيد فلا يبقى من آثار النفس وظلماتها شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning day into night means the heart's suns are eclipsed, as if night endures and dawn has disappeared.
rows.anchor: حتى كأن شموس القلوب كسفت ، أو كأن الليل دام ، وكأن الصبح فقد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bringing the living from the dead signifies the end of spiritual hiatus, renewal of the covenant of union, and hearts becoming fresh and tender again.
rows.anchor: حتى كأن الفترة لم تكن ، وعهد الوصال رجع فتيا ، وعود القلوب غضا طريا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bringing the dead from the living signifies barren hope and loss of spiritual goodness, like trees producing only thorns; he links this state to hearts and eyes turned away after an earlier refusal of faith.
rows.anchor: وتخرج الميت من الحي حتى كأن شجرة البرم أورقت شوكا وأزهرت شوكا ، وكأن اليائس لم يجد خيرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's unmeasured provision brings nights of ease, days of joy, hours of gracious gifts, and moments of nearness without toil or exertion.
rows.anchor: حتى لا ( كدر ) ولا جهد ولا عرق جبين ، ولا تعب يمين ، ليله روح وراحة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The favors produced by these states cannot be counted by speech or fully expressed; the passage only points toward how to describe them.
rows.anchor: لا يحصرها لسان ، ولا يأتي على استقصاء كنهها عبارة ولا بيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When God strips kingship, anyone who assumed himself a king breaks and learns that submission is better for preserving his rule than pride.
rows.anchor: انكسر خمار كل ظان أنه ملك لأنه شاهد ملكه يعرض للزوال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The true king is the person whom nothing distracts from witnessing the One who is truly King.
rows.anchor: الملك في الحقيقة - من لا يشغله شيء بالالتفات إليه عن شهود من هو الملك على الحقيقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A defining truth of faith is loyalty for God's sake and enmity for God's sake.
rows.anchor: من حقائق الإيمان الموالاة في الله والمعاداة في الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The self is the first one to shun, since it is innately magian, claiming everything as mine, from me, and through me.
rows.anchor: وأولى من تسومه الهجران والإعراض عن الكفار - نفسك ؛ فإنها مجبولة على المجوسية حيث تقول : لي ومني وبي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spiritual path's faith is rare; ordinary people who lack it do not merit one's alliance even if they practice great asceticism and exertion.
rows.anchor: ومن لا إيمان له بهذه الطريقة من العوام - وإن كانوا قد بلغوا من الزهد والجهد مبلغا عظيما - فليسوا بأهل لموالاتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Adam and Jesus are distinguished: Adam by being the beginning, Jesus by the honored divine breathing of spirit into him; both remain temporal, created beings.
rows.anchor: خصهما بتطهير الروح عن التناسخ في الأصلاب وأفرد آدم بصفة البدء ؛ وعيسى عليه السلام بتخصيص نفخ الروح فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The truth from Muhammad's Lord means he must not doubt that no one shares God's power to originate creation; existing things began from hidden nonexistence with God and return to Him.
rows.anchor: فلا تشكن في أنه - سبحانه - لا يماثله في الإيجاد أحد ، ولا على إثبات بينه لمخلوق قدرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the truth has become clear and Muhammad knows it inwardly, he should not hesitate to challenge opponents to mutual imprecation, trusting God's victory, protection, and nearness.
rows.anchor: فلا تحتشم من حملهم على المباهلة ، وثق بأن لك القهر والنصرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Had the opponents accepted mutual imprecation, fire would have engulfed the valleys, but God delayed this because believers remained among their descendants.
rows.anchor: ولو أنهم رغبوا في هذه المباهلة لأحرقت الأودية عليهم نيرانا مؤججة ، ولكن أخر الله - سبحانه - ذلك عنهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As an inward sign, when the lights of the truthful appear, those whose state falls short of theirs lose their traces and have no confession to offer.
rows.anchor: فإنه إذا ظهرت أنوارهم انخنست آثار هؤلاء فلا إقرار ، ولا عنهم آثار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The true account admits no doubt against the proofs of oneness; no created imagination can grasp God's wisdom or constrain Him as an object of knowledge or estimation.
rows.anchor: لا يتسلط على شواهد التوحيد غبار شبهة ، ولا يدرك سر حكمه وهم مخلوق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If opponents turn away, false doubts cannot stand before the radiance of Muhammad's light.
rows.anchor: فإن تولوا - يا محمد - فإنه لا ثبات عند شعاع أنوارك لشبهة مبطل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows corrupters: He may destroy them or patiently delay until their expectations strengthen, then seize them suddenly without aid.
rows.anchor: إما يجتاحهم ، أو يحلم حتى إذا استمكنت ظنونهم يأخذهم بغتة وهم لا ينصرون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The common word offered to the People of the Book is the oneness of God, witnessed as the sole originator of things.
rows.anchor: هي كلمة التوحيد وإفراد الحق سبحانه في إنشاء الأشياء بالشهود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worshipping God alone inwardly means not directing one's secret toward any creature; no other should be one's aim or object of witnessing, and the self is the first other to efface from awareness.
rows.anchor: لا تطالع بسرك مخلوقا . وكما لا يكون غيره معبودك فينبغي ألا يكون غيره مقصودك ولا مشهودك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Not taking people as lords is shown by abandoning praise, blame, complaint, and doubt about them, and by attributing no particle of independent agency to them.
rows.anchor: ويظهر صدق هذا بترك المدح والذم لهم . ونفي الشكوى والشك عنهم

rows.speaker: لبيد
rows.claim: Labid's verse is cited as the truest Arab saying: everything except God is false and every delight must pass away.
rows.anchor: قال ( أصدق كلمة قالتها العرب قول لبيد ) ألا كل شيء ما خلا الله باطل . . . وكل نعيم لا محالة زائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who stayed away from the truth gained no benefit; they were afflicted by many trials without realizing it and face God's rejection and everlasting punishment.
rows.anchor: بقوا عن الحق ، وما استمتعوا بحظ ، جمع عليهم فنون المحن ولكنهم لا يدرون ما أصابهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse's inward warning concerns false spiritual claimants who beautify their phrases and say things absent from their hearts, misleading novices and the unlearned into believing they possess realization.
rows.anchor: الإشارة من هذه الآية إلى المبطلين في الدعاوى في هذه الطريقة . يزينون العبارات ، ويطلقون ألسنتهم بما لا خبر في قلوبهم منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Like those who falsely represent their words as scripture, these claimants deceive the weak, while people of true realization see through them.
rows.anchor: كذلك أرباب التلبيس والتدليس ، يروجون قالتهم على المستضعفين ، فأما أهل الحقائق فأسرارهم عندهم مكشوفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These people knowingly speak falsehood from ruined hearts and veiled secrets; the author seeks refuge from deserving divine rejection.
rows.anchor: يتكلمون عن قلوب خربة ، وأسرار محجوبة ، نعوذ بالله من استحقاق المقت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's chosen prophets and saints do not call people to themselves or their own interests; election to prophecy entails protection from such error, and messengers and friends call people to God.
rows.anchor: أي ليس من صفة من اختراناه للنبوة واصطفيناه للولاية أن يدعو الخلق إلى نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rabbani means that prophets and saints direct people to become devoted to the Lord.
rows.anchor: وهو معنى قوله تعالى : { ولكن كونوا ربانيين } أي إنما أشار بهم على الخلق بأن يكونوا ربانيين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Linguistically, rabbani is an adjective related to rabb, on the pattern of other nisba adjectives.
rows.anchor: والرباني منسوب إلى الرب كما يقال فلان دقياني ولحياني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A rabbani knows and is forbearing in God, has relinquished self-interest, and is absorbed in the realities of divine existence beyond awareness of personal states; he speaks, hears, and sees by God, effaced from all else.
rows.anchor: وهم العلماء بالله الحلماء في الله القائمون بفنائهم عن غير الله ، المستهلكة حظوظهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is said that a rabbani has risen above the shadow of self and lives under God's shadow.
rows.anchor: ويقال الرباني من ارتفع عنه ظل نفسه ، وعاش في كنف ظله - سبحانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is said that a rabbani affirms no one but his Lord and attributes no particle of annihilation or establishment to anyone else.
rows.anchor: ويقال الرباني الذي لا يثبت غير ربه موحدا ، ولا يشهد ذرة من المحو والإثبات لغيره أو من غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is said that the rabbani is realized in God's existence yet effaced from witnessing himself, with God acting and directing all that concerns him.
rows.anchor: ويقال الرباني من هو محق في وجوده - سبحانه - ومحو عن شهوده ، فالقائم عنه غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some derive the word name from elevation and others from a mark; both derivations support inward readings.
rows.anchor: قال إنه مشتق من السمو وهو العلو ، ومنهم من قال إنه مشتق من السمة وهي الكبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Under the elevation derivation, remembering God raises one's rank, knowing Him raises one's state, and companionship with Him raises one's aspiration; these bring abundant rewards, inward lights, and escape from base attachments.
rows.anchor: فمن قال إنه مشتق من السمو فهو اسم من ذكره سمت رتبته ، ومن عرفه سمت حاللته ، ومن صحبه سمت همته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Under the mark derivation, seeking God marks one with worship, companionship with intention, love with the mark of the elect, and knowledge with the mark of the chosen.
rows.anchor: ومن قال أصله من السمة فهو اسم من قصده وسم بسمة العبادة ، ومن صحبه وسم بسمة الإرادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The worshipper's mark protects from the fire, the seeker is too honored for the Garden to enslave him, and the elect's mark removes self-conceit about deserving closeness.
rows.anchor: فسمة العبادة توجب هيبة النار أن ترمي صاحبها بشررها ، وسمة الإرادة توجب حشمة الجنان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mark of the special ones is the heart's grief of separation; union with God elevates His rank beyond imagining, while distance brands the heart with separation.
rows.anchor: وسمة وسم بكي الفرقة قلبه . ويقال اسم من واصله سما عنده ( عن ) الأوهام قدره ( سبحانه )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The word people is a collective noun, and its derivation is not strong.
rows.anchor: الناس اسم جنس ، والاشتقاق فيه غير قوي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is said that insan derives from visibility; inwardly, people appeared from nonexistence under obligation, while God honors some with knowledge and guidance and disposes of all as He wills.
rows.anchor: وقيل سمي الإنس إنسا لظهوره فعلى هذه الإشارة : يا من ظهرتم عن كتم العدم بحكم تكليفي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is said God brought people forth from nonexistence as their likenesses and disclosed to no one else the states He disclosed to them.
rows.anchor: ويقال لم أظهر من العدم أمثالكم ، ولم أظهر على أحد ما أظهرت عليكم من أحوالكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is said insan derives from forgetfulness: forgetting God is the lowest condition and forgetting His remembrance the most abased state.
rows.anchor: ويقال سميت إنسانا لنسيانك ، فإن نسيتني فلا شيء أخس منك ، وإن نسيت ذكري فلا أحد أحط منك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever forgets the Real has no end to tribulation, while whoever forgets creation has no end to spiritual elevation.
rows.anchor: من نسي الحق فلا غاية لمحنته ، ومن نسي الخلق فلا نهاية لعلو حالته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God calls sinners who forgot His covenant, rejected His love, and exceeded His limits back to His door to receive gentleness and favor.
rows.anchor: يا من نسيت عهدي ، ورفضت ودي ، وتجاوزت حدي حان لك أن ترجع إلى بابي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God tells the knowers who forgot their own share in Him and turned from all else that their right, support, and rank have become great with Him.
rows.anchor: يا من نسيت فينا حظك ، وصت عن غيرنا لحظك ولفظك - لقد عظم علينا حقك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One who delights in the breeze of nearness, rests in witnessing God's face, and gains honor from His majesty is the most honored servant.
rows.anchor: يا من أنست بنسيم قربي ، واستروحت إلى شهود وجهي ، واعتززت بجلال قدري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taqwa encompasses all obedience, beginning with avoiding associationism and culminating in avoiding every other-than-God; the first other is one's own self.
rows.anchor: التقوى جماع الطاعات ، وأوله ترك الشرك وآخره اتقاء كل غير ، وأول الأغيار لك نفسك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One who guards against the self stands with God without claiming a station or witnessing a spiritual state.
rows.anchor: ومن اتقى نفسه وقف مع الله بلا مقام ولا شهود حال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one who stands for God does so without seeking a share in this world or the next.
rows.anchor: لا لشهود حظ في الدنيا والعقبى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one soul is Adam; since he was created by God's hand, those descended from him share this distinction and are the best of creation.
rows.anchor: وهو آدم عليه السلام ، وإذا كنا مخلوقين منه وهو مخلوق باليد فنحن أيضا كذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The word soul is generic, and its generic sense implies exhaustive inclusion.
rows.anchor: ولفظ ( النفس ) للعموم والعموم يوجب الاستغراق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made creatures dwell with one another so lineage could continue and like could return to like by pairing form with form.
rows.anchor: حكم الحق - سبحانه - بمساكنة الخلق مع الخلق لبقاء النسل ، ولرد المثل إلى المثل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creating all humanity from one person despite their varied bodies, appearances, characters, aspirations, and conditions proves God's power, lordship, and wisdom.
rows.anchor: تعرف إلى العقلاء على كمال القدرة بما ألاح من براهين الربوبية ودلالات الحكمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No two people resemble one another in appearance, character, aspiration, and condition, demonstrating the limitless scope of God's power and knowledge.
rows.anchor: وإن اثنين منهم لا يتشابهان ، فلكل وجه في الصورة والخلق ، والهمة والحالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repeating the command to fear God emphasizes its force.
rows.anchor: ثم قال : { واتقوا الله } تكريرالأمر بالتقوى يدل على تأكيد حكمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The instruction concerning God and kinship means to avoid severing family ties: whoever cuts them is cut off, and whoever joins them is joined.
rows.anchor: أي اتقوا الأرحام أن تقطعوها ، فمن قطع الرحم قطع ، ومن وصلها وصل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's watching means He witnesses and counts breaths, sees the senses, oversees thoughts, and originates movements and stillness.
rows.anchor: مطلعا شهيدا ، يعد عليك أنفاسك ، ويرى حواسك ، وهو متول خطراتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowing that God watches over someone should make that person ashamed before Him.
rows.anchor: ومن علم أنه رقيب عليه فبالحري أن يستحي منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God litigates against a caretaker who violates those in his care and avenges servants more than He avenges Himself; a just and kind orphan guardian has a claim with God, while an abusive one faces God as adversary.
rows.anchor: فجاء على رعيته فخصمه ربه ؛ فإنه - سبحانه - ينتقم لعباده ما لا ينتقم لنفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Free men may marry up to four wives at once but must be just; they should take this permission only if they can fulfill that obligation, since obligations will be questioned.
rows.anchor: أباح الله للرجال الأحرار التزوج بأربع في حالة واحدة ، وأوجب العدل بينهن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Food served freely by generous spiritual youths is wholesome; miserly food is poor because it is given grudgingly rather than with a willing heart.
rows.anchor: دل هذا على أن طعام الفتيان والأسخياء مريء لأنهم لا يطعمون إلا عن طيب نفس
